editors.name: Power Automate
editors.description: Cloud flows in the Power Automate maker portal (OpenApiConnection actions, solution-aware flows).
editors.detect: properties.apiId shared_logicflows, connectionReferences or OpenApiConnection actions

editors.name: Agent Flows
editors.description: Copilot Studio / Agent Builder agent flows (Power Automate engine with an agent-invoked trigger).
editors.detect: Request trigger with kind Skills/Agent, or properties.flowType = agent

editors.name: Azure Logic Apps
editors.description: Consumption and Standard Logic Apps (ARM template or workflow.json).
editors.detect: ARM resources[] of type Microsoft.Logic/workflows, kind Stateful/Stateless, ApiConnection / ServiceProvider actions

editors.name: All editors
editors.description: Rule applies to every workflow editor (also used for the WDL expression rules).
